description: Land Title Settlement Department - Welilanda, Giribawa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420968 (23/0929)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their ownership details, extents, and legal status. The content focuses on land property matters including title declarations, ownership transfers, and land parcel registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). There is no government personnel or structural changes mentioned, only land administration matters.
